label: Intelligibility intuition…: A truth-linked aetiology accounts for having the intelligibility…
term: intelligibility intuition, truth-linked aetiology, withholding and comparative evidence in #115
definition: A truth-linked aetiology accounts for having the intelligibility intuition because it is true. The source contrasts plausible naturalistic and theistic accounts, imposes normative withholding/retention commitments, and concludes comparative evidence for theism over naturalism.
note: The intuition is not defined as unrestricted PSR or certified correspondence. Ought to withhold is not falsity, plausible accounts are not actual truths, and comparative evidence is not a numeric posterior or necessary God existence. Normative scope, truth-link plausibility and evidential transfer require independent interpretation and defense.
